title: Algebra
summary: Linear equations, linear functions and their graphs, and systems of equations and inequalities: the biggest part of the PSAT math section.
bigIdeas: Do the same thing to both sides of an equation, and check your answer by putting it back in.
In $y = mx + b$, the slope $m$ is a rate and $b$ is the starting amount.
Two lines meet once, never (parallel) or everywhere (the same line).
